mapper.select: SELECT U.*, C.USER_PW, I.PROVIDER FROM USER U LEFT JOIN USER_CREDENTIALS C ON U.USER_NO = C.USER_NO LEFT JOIN USER_IDENTITIES I ON U.USER_NO = I.USER_NO WHERE U.USER_NO = #{userNo}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND BOARD_DELETE = 'N') as recipeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SCRAP S JOIN BOARD B ON S.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO WHERE S.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND B.BOARD_DELETE = 'N') as scrapCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INQUIRY WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}) as inquiryCount FROM DUAL
mapper.update: UPDATE USER SET WITHDRAW = 'Y', USER_EMAIL = CONCAT('withdrawn_', #{userNo}, '@cookmate.com'), NICKNAME = '탈퇴한 사용자', PROFILE_IMAGE_URL = NULL, INTRODUCE = NULL, ADDRESS = NULL, LAST_LOGIN = NOW() WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}
mapper.select: SELECT B.BOARD_NO as boardNo, B.BOARD_TITLE as title, B.IMAGE_URL as imageUrl, T.TYPE_NAME as category, T.COOK_TIME as cookTime, B.OPEN as open, B.LIKES_COUNT as likesCount, B.BOARD_POSTDATE as boardPostdate FROM BOARD B JOIN TAG T ON B.TYPE_NO = T.TYPE_NO WHERE B.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND B.BOARD_DELETE = 'N' ORDER BY B.BOARD_POSTDATE DESC

SELECT B.BOARD_NO as boardNo, B.BOARD_TITLE as title, B.IMAGE_URL as imageUrl, T.TYPE_NAME as category, T.COOK_TIME as cookTime, B.LIKES_COUNT as likesCount, M.NICKNAME as authorNickname FROM SCRAP S JOIN BOARD B ON S.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO JOIN TAG T ON B.TYPE_NO = T.TYPE_NO JOIN USER M ON B.USER_NO = M.USER_NO WHERE S.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND B.BOARD_DELETE = 'N' ORDER BY B.BOARD_POSTDATE DESC

SELECT INQUIRY_NO as inquiryNo, INQUIRY_TITLE as title, INQUIRY_CONTENT as content, INQUIRY_POSTDATE as createDate, INQUIRY_STATUS as status, TYPE_NAME as typeName FROM INQUIRY WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} ORDER BY INQUIRY_POSTDATE DESC

SELECT INQUIRY_NO as inquiryNo, USER_NO as userNo, INQUIRY_TITLE as title, INQUIRY_CONTENT as content, INQUIRY_POSTDATE as createDate, TYPE_NAME as typeName, INQUIRY_STATUS as status, ANSWER as answer, ANSWER_DATE as answerDate FROM INQUIRY WHERE INQUIRY_NO = #{inquiryNo}

SELECT u.USER_NO as userNo, u.NICKNAME as nickname, u.PROFILE_IMAGE_URL as profileImageUrl, u.USER_EMAIL as userEmail, DATE_FORMAT(u.USER_ENROLL_DATE, '%Y.%m.%d') as enrollDate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD b WHERE b.USER_NO = u.USER_NO AND b.BOARD_DELETE = 'N') as recipeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SCRAP s JOIN BOARD b ON s.BOARD_NO = b.BOARD_NO WHERE b.USER_NO = u.USER_NO AND b.BOARD_DELETE = 'N') as scrapCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FOLLOWING f WHERE f.FOLLOWING_ID = u.USER_EMAIL) as followerCount
, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FOLLOWING WHERE USER_NO = #{loginUserNo} AND FOLLOWING_ID = u.USER_EMAIL) > 0 as isFollowing
FROM USER u WHERE u.WITHDRAW = 'N' AND u.USER_STATUS = 'N' ORDER BY
scrapCount DESC followerCount DESC recipeCount DESC

SELECT USER_NO as userNo, USER_EMAIL as userEmail, NICKNAME as nickname, INTRODUCE as introduce, PROFILE_IMAGE_URL as profileImageUrl, DATE_FORMAT(USER_ENROLL_DATE, '%Y.%m.%d') as enrollDate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD WHERE USER_NO = #{chefNo} AND BOARD_DELETE = 'N') as recipeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FOLLOWING WHERE FOLLOWING_ID = (SELECT USER_EMAIL FROM USER WHERE USER_NO = #{chefNo})) as followerCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FOLLOWING WHERE USER_NO = #{chefNo}) as followingCount
, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FOLLOWING WHERE USER_NO = #{loginUserNo} AND FOLLOWING_ID = (SELECT USER_EMAIL FROM USER WHERE USER_NO = #{chefNo})) > 0 as isFollowing
FROM USER WHERE USER_NO = #{chefNo} AND WITHDRAW = 'N'

SELECT c.COMMENT_NO as commentNo, c.COMMENT_CONTENT as commentContent, DATE_FORMAT(c.COMMENT_POSTDATE, '%Y.%m.%d') as commentPostDate, b.BOARD_NO as boardNo, b.BOARD_TITLE as boardTitle, u.NICKNAME as commenterNickname, u.PROFILE_IMAGE_URL as commenterProfileUrl FROM COMMENT c JOIN BOARD b ON c.BOARD_NO = b.BOARD_NO JOIN USER u ON c.USER_NO = u.USER_NO WHERE b.USER_NO = #{chefNo} AND c.COMMENT_DELETE = 'N' ORDER BY c.COMMENT_POSTDATE DESC

SELECT c.COMMENT_NO as commentNo, c.COMMENT_CONTENT as commentContent, DATE_FORMAT(c.COMMENT_POSTDATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as commentPostDate, b.BOARD_NO as boardNo, b.BOARD_TITLE as boardTitle, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENT r WHERE r.PARENT_COMMENT_NO = c.COMMENT_NO AND r.COMMENT_DELETE = 'N') as replyCount FROM COMMENT c JOIN BOARD b ON c.BOARD_NO = b.BOARD_NO WHERE c.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND c.COMMENT_DELETE = 'N'
ORDER BY replyCount DESC, c.COMMENT_POSTDATE DESC
ORDER BY c.COMMENT_POSTDATE ASC
ORDER BY c.COMMENT_POSTDATE DESC

SELECT c.COMMENT_NO as commentNo, c.COMMENT_CONTENT as commentContent, DATE_FORMAT(c.COMMENT_POSTDATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as commentPostDate, b.BOARD_NO as boardNo, b.BOARD_TITLE as boardTitle, u.NICKNAME as commenterNickname, u.PROFILE_IMAGE_URL as commenterProfileUrl, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENT r WHERE r.PARENT_COMMENT_NO = c.COMMENT_NO AND r.COMMENT_DELETE = 'N') as replyCount FROM COMMENT c JOIN BOARD b ON c.BOARD_NO = b.BOARD_NO JOIN USER u ON c.USER_NO = u.USER_NO WHERE b.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND c.USER_NO != #{userNo} AND c.COMMENT_DELETE = 'N'
ORDER BY replyCount DESC, c.COMMENT_POSTDATE DESC
ORDER BY c.COMMENT_POSTDATE ASC
ORDER BY c.COMMENT_POSTDATE DESC

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM FOLLOWING WHERE USER_NO = #{loginUserNo} AND FOLLOWING_ID = #{targetEmail}
